propositions: Reconciler re-attempts identical structurally-impossible inbound link writes on every pass because failed links never land a LINK event and are re-emitted unchanged by the differ, causing 200+ doomed writes/hour and a permanent WARNING floor in logs.

Three deterministic error shapes (closed source, redundant ancestry, cycle) are raised by add_dependency and occur repeatedly because the applier only warns and continues with no durable memory of the failure.
Inbound link ADD failures must be classified and recorded with a digest over the structural inputs that decided the verdict, then skipped on subsequent passes until those inputs change.
The impossible links record must be committed to the tickets branch in a separate file from bindings.json so it persists across CI checkouts where each reconcile pass runs in a fresh clone.

Cycle impossibility records must key on the global structural projection (all tickets' status/parent/deps) because add_dependency walks the transitive graph and an intermediate ticket change can break a cycle while endpoints remain unchanged.
